documents.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.description: Mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information while evaluating or pursuing a business relationship.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.description: How Confidential Information may be used.
fields.default: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the MNDA starts.

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.description: How long the MNDA lasts: expires a number of years after the Effective Date, or continues until terminated in accordance with the terms of the MNDA.

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.description: How long Confidential Information is protected: a number of years from the Effective Date (trade secrets stay protected while they remain trade secrets), or in perpetuity.
fields.default: 1 year from Effective Date, but in the case of trade secrets until Confidential Information is no longer considered a trade secret under applicable laws.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the MNDA, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.description: The city or county and state whose courts hear disputes, e.g. New Castle, DE.

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.description: Any changes to the Standard Terms.

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability, and term and termination.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts.

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: The date of the Order Form for the subscription.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: How long the subscription to the Cloud Service lasts, e.g. 12 months from the Order Date.

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: What Customer pays for the Cloud Service and when, e.g. $1,000 per month, billed annually in advance.

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.description: The support Provider gives during the Subscription Period, e.g. email support on business days.

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: How far ahead a party must give notice to stop the subscription renewing, e.g. 30 days before the end of the Subscription Period.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: The overall limit on each party's liability, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim.

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims Provider will defend Customer against, e.g. claims that the Cloud Service infringes intellectual property rights.

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims Customer will defend Provider against, e.g. claims arising from Customer Content.

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: The data processing agreement between the parties, if any, e.g. the Common Paper DPA dated the Effective Date, or None.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The state or country whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware.

documents.name: Software License Agreement
documents.description: Standard terms for licensing installable or on-premise software, covering license scope, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, and liability.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts.

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: The date of the Order Form for the license.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: How long the license lasts, e.g. 12 months from the Order Date.

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: How far ahead a party must give notice to stop the license renewing, e.g. 30 days before the end of the Subscription Period.

fields.label: Permitted Uses
fields.description: What Customer may use the software for, e.g. internal business purposes.

fields.label: License Limits
fields.description: Limits on the license, e.g. number of users, devices or installations.

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.description: The fees and how they are invoiced and paid, e.g. $20,000 per year, invoiced annually, due within 30 days.

fields.label: Warranty Period
fields.description: How long Provider warrants the software will work as documented, e.g. 90 days from delivery.

fields.label: Deletion Procedure
fields.description: How Customer removes the software when the agreement ends, e.g. uninstall and certify deletion within 30 days.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: The overall limit on each party's liability, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim.

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.description: A higher liability limit for Increased Claims, e.g. 3x the General Cap Amount, or None.

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.description: Claims subject to the Increased Cap Amount instead of the general cap, e.g. breaches of confidentiality, or None.

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.description: Claims with no liability cap, e.g. fraud or wilful misconduct, or None.

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims Provider will defend Customer against, e.g. claims that the software infringes intellectual property rights.

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims Customer will defend Provider against, e.g. claims arising from Customer's misuse of the software.

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.description: Any warranties beyond the standard ones, or None.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The state or country whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware.

documents.name: Professional Services Agreement
documents.description: Standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services and deliver work product under statements of work.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts.

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.description: The services and work product Provider will deliver under the statement of work (SOW).

fields.label: SOW Term
fields.description: How long the statement of work lasts, e.g. 3 months from the Effective Date.

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: What Customer pays for the services, e.g. a fixed fee of $50,000 or $200 per hour.

fields.label: Payment Period
fields.description: How long Customer has to pay invoices, e.g. 30 days from receipt.

fields.label: Customer Obligations
fields.description: What Customer must provide for Provider to do the work, e.g. access to systems and staff.

fields.label: Rejection Period
fields.description: How long Customer has to review and reject a Deliverable, e.g. 10 business days.

fields.label: Resubmission Period
fields.description: How long Provider has to fix and resubmit a rejected Deliverable, e.g. 10 business days.

fields.label: Time of Assignment
fields.description: When ownership of Deliverables passes to Customer, e.g. on payment in full.

fields.label: Insurance Minimums
fields.description: Insurance Provider must carry, e.g. $1M general liability, or None.

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.description: Provider's security policy, if any, e.g. a URL, or None.

fields.label: Customer Policies
fields.description: Customer policies Provider must follow on site or in Customer systems, or None.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: The overall limit on each party's liability, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim.

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.description: A higher liability limit for Increased Claims, e.g. 3x the General Cap Amount, or None.

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.description: Claims subject to the Increased Cap Amount instead of the general cap, or None.

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.description: Claims with no liability cap, or None.

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims Provider will defend Customer against, e.g. claims that the Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims Customer will defend Provider against, e.g. claims arising from materials Customer provides.

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.description: Any warranties beyond the standard ones, or None.

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: The data processing agreement between the parties, if any, or None.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The state or country whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware.

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.description: Service level commitments for a cloud service, including uptime targets, support response times, and service credits for failures to meet them.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: The subscription the SLA applies to, e.g. 12 months from the Order Date.

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.description: The monthly availability Provider aims for, e.g. 99.9%.

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.description: Planned maintenance that does not count as downtime, e.g. up to 4 hours per month with 48 hours' notice.

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.description: The service credit if uptime falls below target, e.g. 10% of monthly fees.

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.description: Where Customer sends support requests, e.g. support@provider.com.

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.description: How quickly Provider aims to respond to support requests, e.g. 4 business hours.

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.description: The service credit if response times are missed, e.g. 5% of monthly fees.

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.description: Terms governing the processing of personal data by a provider on behalf of a customer, including GDPR-style processor obligations, subprocessors, security, and international transfers.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main agreement this DPA supplements, e.g. the Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2026.

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.description: What Provider does with the personal data and why, e.g. hosting and processing data to provide the service.

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.description: How long processing continues, e.g. for the term of the Agreement.

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.description: How often personal data is transferred, e.g. continuous.

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.description: The kinds of personal data processed, e.g. names, email addresses, usage data.

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.description: Whose personal data is processed, e.g. Customer's employees and end users.

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.description: Any sensitive personal data processed (health, biometric, etc.), or None.

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.description: Extra safeguards for special category data, or None.

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.description: Subprocessors Provider may use, e.g. Amazon Web Services (hosting), or a link to a list.

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.description: Provider's security measures, e.g. a URL to its security policy.

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.description: Who Customer contacts about security incidents, e.g. security@provider.com.

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.description: The EU member state whose law governs the EEA Standard Contractual Clauses, e.g. Ireland.

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a service provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information on behalf of a covered entity.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main services agreement this BAA supplements, e.g. the Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2026.

fields.label: BAA Effective Date
fields.description: The date the BAA starts.

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.description: How quickly Provider must report a breach of unsecured PHI, e.g. 5 business days after discovery.

fields.label: Limitations
fields.description: Restrictions on how Provider uses or discloses PHI, e.g. no offshoring of PHI and no de-identification, or None.

documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.description: Addendum to a services agreement covering the provider's use of AI services, including treatment of customer input and output and restrictions on training models with customer data.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the addendum starts.

fields.label: Training Data
fields.description: Which of Customer's inputs or outputs Provider may use to train models, or None if training is not allowed.

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.description: What Provider may train models for, e.g. improving the product for Customer only, or None.

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.description: Conditions on training, e.g. data must be de-identified first, or None.

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.description: Limits on using inputs and outputs to improve the AI system other than by training, or None.

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement
documents.description: Agreement for early-stage customers who get access to a product in development in exchange for providing feedback to the provider.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the agreement starts.

fields.label: Program
fields.description: The design partner program: the product in development and how Partner will give feedback, e.g. monthly feedback calls.

fields.label: Term
fields.description: How long the agreement lasts, e.g. 6 months from the Effective Date.

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: What Partner pays for early access, if anything, e.g. None.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The state or country whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware.

documents.name: Partnership Agreement
documents.description: Agreement for business partnerships such as referral, reseller, or co-marketing arrangements, covering cooperation, trademarks, payments, and confidentiality.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the partnership starts.

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: The date the partnership ends.

fields.label: Obligations
fields.description: What each party will do in the partnership, e.g. Partner refers customers and Company pays a referral fee.

fields.label: Territory
fields.description: Where the partnership applies, e.g. North America, or worldwide.

fields.label: Payment Schedule
fields.description: When payments between the parties are due, e.g. quarterly in arrears, or None.

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.description: How payments are made, e.g. invoice and bank transfer within 30 days, or None.

fields.label: Brand Guidelines
fields.description: Rules for using each other's trademarks, e.g. a URL to brand guidelines, or None.

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.description: Any warranties beyond the standard ones, or None.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: The overall limit on each party's liability, e.g. $100,000.

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.description: A higher liability limit for Increased Claims, or None.

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.description: Claims subject to the Increased Cap Amount instead of the general cap, or None.

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.description: Claims with no liability cap, or None.

fields.label: Company Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims Company will defend Partner against, or None.

fields.label: Partner Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims Partner will defend Company against, or None.

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: The data processing agreement between the parties, if any, or None.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The state or country whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware.

documents.name: Pilot Agreement
documents.description: Terms for a limited-time trial or pilot of a product before the customer commits to a full commercial agreement.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the pilot agreement starts.

fields.label: Pilot Period
fields.description: How long the pilot lasts, e.g. 60 days from the Effective Date.

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: The overall limit on each party's liability, e.g. $10,000.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The state or country whose laws govern the agreement, e.g. Delaware.

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts in New Castle County, Delaware.
